reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API observed 2026-10-03 reports an active CHFm trove on Celo with USDm collateral, matching the exact CHFm backing configuration (including the Monad lockbox representation). The sole direct collateral category is USDm, so the whole direct-collateral denominator remains one USDm slice. This is an issuer-reported category composition, not independent collateral solvency assurance, immediate realizability, or a measurement of USDm's upstream reserves.
